knownLimits: Four Loko has four carefully selected genuine frames from Nick’s supplied video, not standalone photographs. They preserve the original portrait frame and embedded letterboxing. Its cover position deliberately frames both faces for a wide card.
Sundance combines three attributed photographs and six identified real video stills from Nick’s supplied reel.
LinkedIn sources publish several photos at 800px width. They remain at their source resolution, rather than being artificially enlarged.
WcDonald’s gallery combines its primary agency case-study photo with credited McDonald’s press photographs published by Anime Trending. Credits and source pages are retained per image.
gaps: No full exterior photograph of the Four Loko Party Store was found in the supplied public post; selected reel frames show real guest interactions and interior branding. No unrelated older Four Loko Bodega images were used.
